india.one_line: Indian IT firms, startups, and GCCs are forming AI partnerships, securing leadership, and focusing on monetisation.

themes.title: Enterprise AI adoption and monetisation shifts
themes.text: IT services firms and Global Capability Centres are partnering to deploy enterprise AI solutions. Meanwhile, reports indicate that IT firms requiring lower capital to monetise AI may gain investor advantage.

stories.headline: IT firms with lower capital requirements may gain as investors shift focus to AI monetisation: Report
India's GCCs and IT firms form enterprise AI partnerships

themes.title: Sarvam AI appoints new executive leader
themes.text: Indian startup Sarvam AI appointed former Google Cloud India Managing Director Sashikumar Sreedharan as President and Chief Business Officer.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI appoints ex-Google Cloud India MD Sashikumar Sreedharan as President and CBO
